title: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One
arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
latin: Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
translation: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.
lesson: Tawhid in its purest form. Reciting this equals one third of Quran in reward. It's a daily reset to monotheism.
